The Problem Statement
• Current physical surveillance systems rely heavily on manual monitoring.
• Existing AI tools in the market are often used in inefficient way.
Research Summary
Integration of face detection, face recognition, and AI features into a real-time web application to automate threat identification and security analytics.

Case 3: Static Premises
Centrally mounted AI cameras (45° angle) providing 100% automated monitoring of commercial premises.
slides.narration: In Case 3: Static Premises, we use central AI cameras that are mounted at a 45-degree angle. These cameras cover the entire area of commercial premises, ensuring that every corner is monitored. Think of them like security guards, but instead of standing in one spot, they can see everything from above. This way, no part of the area is left unwatched. It's like having a big, smart security system that can see and respond to anything that happens, making commercial spaces safer and more efficient.

slides.title:
🛡️ Multi-tier Login & Role-based Permissions
🛡️ Email Authentication & Supreme User Auth
🛡️ Sha256 Encrypted Passwords
🛡️ Token-based API Security
🛡️ Encrypted Communication & Data Sanitization
🛡️Usage of RESTful API
slides.narration: On this slide, we're talking about how our system uses multi-tier login to ensure only the right people can access important parts of our system. Think of it like a security door that only lets in people with the right key. We use email to make sure you're who you say you are, like checking a driver's license. We also use a very strong password, like a super strong lock, to make sure no one can guess it. We use something called tokens, which are like a special card you need to use to get in, and we make sure all the information you share stays private, like protecting a secret. Finally, we use a type of internet language called RESTful API to talk to the system, just like how you might use a secret code with your friends to talk to each other in a game. This way, only people who should be in charge can access the important parts, just like how only someone who knows the secret code can play a game.

Our Edge AI solution helps by taking over the security tasks, reducing the need for manual labor. This not only saves money but also makes the security process more accurate and reliable. Think of it like having a smart robot security guard instead of relying on people to watch over everything.
